pairs: Cumque vidisset Balaam quod placeret Domino ut benediceret Israëli,
And when Balaam had seen that it was pleasing to the Lord that he should bless Israel,
he by no means went out as he had gone before,
sed dirigens contra desertum vultum suum,
But directing his face opposite the desert,
vidit Israël in tentoriis commorantem per tribus suas:
he saw Israel dwelling in tents by their tribes.
et irruente in se spiritu Dei,
And with the Spirit of God rushing into him,
the man whose eye has been obstructed,
the hearer of the sermon of God,
he who has gazed upon a vision of the Almighty,
he who falls down and so his eyes are opened,
like gardens irrigated next to rivers,
like tabernacles which the Lord has fixed,
Water shall flow from his jar,
et semen illius erit in aquas multas.
and his offspring shall be amid many waters,
and his kingdom shall be removed.
Away from Egypt, God has led him,
whose strength is like the rhinoceros.
Devorabunt gentes hostes illius, ossaque eorum confringent,
They shall devour the nations that are his enemies, and break their bones,
he has slept like a lion,
whom no one would dare to awaken.
And Balak, being angry against Balaam,
clapped his hands together and said:
Ad maledicendum inimicis meis vocavi te,
“I called you to curse my enemies, and,
to the contrary, you have blessed them three times.
I had decided, indeed, to honor you greatly,
sed Dominus privavit te honore disposito.
but the Lord has deprived you of the designated honor.”
Respondit Balaam ad Balac: Nonne nuntiis tuis,
Balaam responded to Balak: “Did I not say to your messengers,
Si dederit mihi Balac plenam domum suam argenti et auri,
Even if Balak would give me his house, filled with silver and gold,
non potero præterire sermonem Domini Dei mei,
I still could not go away from the word of the Lord my God,
ut vel boni quid vel mali proferam ex corde meo:
so as to offer anything, either good or evil, from my own heart;
but whatever the Lord will speak, this, too,
as I continue on to my own people,
quid populus tuus populo huic faciat extremo tempore.
I will give you counsel as to what this people shall do to your people in the end times.”
the man whose eye has been obstructed,
the hearer of the sermon of God,
he who knows the doctrine of the Most High,
and who sees the visions of the Almighty, who,
falling down, has his eyes opened, has declared:
A star shall rise out of Jacob,
and a rod shall spring up from Israel.
And he shall strike down the commanders of Moab,
and he shall devastate all the sons of Seth.
Et erit Idumæa possessio ejus: hæreditas Seir cedet inimicis suis:
And he shall possess Idumea; the inheritance of Seir shall fall to their enemies.
Yet truly, Israel shall act with strength.
From Jacob will be he who shall be ruler.
And he shall perish the remnants of the city.”
taking up his parable, he said:
whose very end shall be perdition.”
and taking up his parable, he said:
sed si in petra posueris nidum tuum,
But though you will set your nest in a rock,
et fueris electus de stirpe Cin,
and you will be elect among the stock of Kain,
how long will you be able to remain?
For Assur shall take you captive.”
And taking up his parable once more he said:
Who will be able to survive,
when God will do these things?
They shall arrive in Greek warships from Italy.
and they shall devastate the Hebrews,
et ad extremum etiam ipsi peribunt.
and yet, at the very end, even they themselves shall perish.”
et reversus est in locum suum:
and he returned to his place.
